items.suggested_title: Water in the basement after heavy rain: causes, fixes and when it is a restoration job
items.notes: Strong local hook without being a location page: Connoquenessing Creek (Zelienople, Butler) and Breakneck Creek (Mars, Evans City) put low-lying blocks on flood alert in cloudburst summers, and Cranberry and Seven Fields sit on sump-dependent newer builds. Separate the three causes clearly (surface grading and downspouts, hydrostatic seepage through block walls, sump or drain failure) because the insurance answer differs for each: groundwater seepage is usually excluded, sump failure needs a rider, storm-driven surface flooding needs NFIP. Writer should note FireDEX does the cleanup and drying, not foundation waterproofing.
